location.label: Golden Gate Park Polo Fields, San Francisco — authored grass subset
location.site_geometry: Schematic 4 ha grass subset inside the playing-field setting; no WGS84 polygon or surveyed fit is asserted. Rotate/place visually within turf using the official field map; never extend into trees/track without remodelling.

weather_station.name: SAN FRANCISCO DOWNTOWN
weather_station.coordinates_are: weather station only; approximately 5.8 km east of Polo Fields, not an on-field gauge

location.habitat_reference: Managed natural-grass sports field, not forest or exposed agricultural field. Surrounding woodland, tracks, stands and offsite works excluded.

event.use: Replay the same recorded daily depth on each surface state, holding average antecedent runoff condition fixed. Not a reconstruction of actual storm runoff; no return period assigned.

cn_method.antecedent_condition: ARC II, average; scenario assumption, not measured 2014 moisture

site_area_m2.note: Authored 4 ha demo area, not the whole ~10 ha venue. Site footprint including internal infrastructure, not floor area.

cleared_area_m2.note: 3.2 ha turf removal/works; 0.8 ha retained turf; no trees counted or removed in this scenario.

roof_area_m2.note: Authored 1.2 ha building roof footprint; no inferred capacity/floor count.

other_impervious_area_m2.note: 1.6 ha internal roads, parking, utilities and water infrastructure. Existing tracks and external works excluded.

landscaped_area_m2.note: 0.4 ha rehabilitated good-cover landscape, not necessarily mature on opening day.

hydrologic_soil_group.note: Selected illustrative sports-field soil group, NOT a soil survey. Sandy park history does not establish actual HSG; A/C/D sensitivity required.

dust_allowance_l_m2_workday.note: Combined dust suppression/soil-wetting allowance. Close to CEC rough heuristic; not a geotechnical compaction requirement. Eligible days are authored net watering workdays, not automatically all dry days from monthly rainfall.

concrete_volume_m3.note: Authored material allowance, not a measured structural design or generic hectares-to-concrete coefficient.

concrete_mixing_water_l_m3.note: Authored example recipe. Count mixing water at offsite batching separately from water delivered to site; no claim of full concrete LCA.

curing_area_m2.note: One selected curing surface allowance, not all floors.

curing_l_m2_day.note: Budget allowance, not a prescribed curing method or validated water demand.

curing_days.note: Budget duration; sufficient curing depends on actual design and method.

construction_workers.note: Average water-budget headcount; not a workforce forecast.

commissioning_workdays.note: Selected commissioning period, outside the 215 construction workdays.

cooling_initial_fill_m3.note: Selected one-time cooling inventory, not evaporation.

fire_initial_fill_m3.note: Selected one-time stock, not annual consumption.

roof_tank_capacity_m3.note: Selected roof-only storage within hardstanding footprint.

roof_tank_initial_m3.note: Empty at start of each independent event replay. No annual harvesting simulation.

average_it_load_mw.note: Authored average IT load, chosen smaller demo capacity. Not derived from 4 ha and not equal capacity to old 20 MW scenario.

cooling_supply_l_kwh_it.note: Same SJ04 design-reference intensity as old demo. Unvalidated transfer to San Francisco; no automatic marine-climate saving.

cycles_of_concentration.note: Selected operating condition matching SJ04 design reference; negligible drift and leaks assumed.

operation_days.note: First full non-leap operating year after opening. No ramp-up simulated.

irrigation_area_m2.note: 0.8 ha retained turf plus 0.4 ha restored cover receive model irrigation in the first operating year.

irrigation_depth_mm_application.note: Selected gross delivered irrigation per application; not a crop/ET measurement.

irrigation_applications.note: Authored first-year schedule: 300 mm gross annual irrigation on both original and final planted area. No annual weather/ET simulation.

water_supply_type.note: Hypothetical potable supply for construction, commissioning, cooling and domestic uses. Irrigation source unverified; total all-source water must not be called total potable supply.

operations_rainwater_supply_credit_m3.note: No annual tank reliability or demand-offset model; do not deduct event capture from annual utility supply.

cooling_technology.note: Chosen outdoor heat rejection permits evaporation; internal closed loop is not zero-water heat rejection. Annual intensity includes unspecified weather-dependent dry/wet operation, not a validated hourly cooling model.

construction_workdays.note: Selected programme: 10 stripping + 30 grading + 15 compaction + 160 construction; then 10 commissioning.

stripping_only_runoff_quantified.note: Sod removal before grading not isolated by chosen TR-55 classes; unknown is not zero.

baseline_irrigation_area_m2.note: The authored 4 ha grass subset only, not whole Polo Fields.

irrigation_supply_type.note: No Polo Fields meter/source attribution established; park programme includes groundwater and recycled transition. Do not claim current active recycled supply or potable savings.

boundaries.construction: Selected onsite and separate offsite concrete mixing inventory; 215 construction working days plus 10 commissioning, not a dated programme. External access/pipe works, dewatering and demolition of unmodelled infrastructure excluded, not asserted zero in a real project.
boundaries.runoff: Generated direct surface runoff volumes; for M5/M6 subtract roof-tank storage in static event accounting. No hydraulic routing, flood depth, peak flow, aquifer recharge or annual runoff.
boundaries.operation: Direct cooling/domestic/irrigation supply, first full 365 days. Compare to an authored no-build irrigation budget for same 4 ha, same 300 mm annual allowance. Baseline is not metered; net total-supply change is not net potable withdrawal or net evaporative consumption.
boundaries.quality: Qualitative causal hazards and controls, no invented sediment masses, turbidity, downstream pH, ecological mortality or pollution occurrence.
boundaries.tank: Volume snapshot immediately after replay: no release/reuse during event; all uncaptured runoff continues to managed site drainage, treatment assigned zero volume-reduction credit. Captured water not called aquifer recharge or evaporative consumption.
